text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Thank you for pacing with me, 
Bouquet-san."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure is all mine— If I was able 
to help... I'm glad."

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me! Can I run alongside you next?" 
"A-Ah, me too!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hooold on a second. ...Are you sure you 
can handle that many opponents, 
Bouquet-chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern... But thanks 
to Trainer-san... I've built up my stamina 
too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it makes me happy. Being able 
to help you like this— and push each other 
to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That sounds just like 
Bouquet-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Excuse me for intruding, but... if 
you are also looking for a training 
partner, Loves-san—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... You saw right through me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—We are rivals competing against one 
another. Even so—there must be times where 
we can achieve "harmony".)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If my presence can help everyone become 
stronger— then I can work even harder.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: Let's do our best again today!
